scripts.name: MovingCubeScript
scripts.scriptString: const cube = context.findInstance('MovingCube'); if (!cube) return; const baseX = 0; const amplitude = 8; const speed = 0.8; cube.x = baseX + Math.sin(time * speed) * amplitude; cube.mesh.position.set(cube.x, cube.y, cube.z); cube.updateHitbox();
